newsitem.title: JAMAICA: German tourist convicted of murder in Jamaica.
newsitem.headline: German tourist convicted of murder in Jamaica.

text.p: German tourist Alexander Von Starck has been found guilty of murdering a Jamaican prostitute and sentenced to life imprisonment.
In a unanimous verdict, a 12-member jury handed down the sentence after deliberating 35 minutes on Friday.
Von Starck was arrested in August 1995 after Michelle Kornell, 22, was found dead in his hotel room in Montego Bay. Kornell's heart had been removed and several of her ribs were broken.
Police said Von Starck had confessed to the murder. They found a bloodstained knife in his possession.

The accused told the court that he had gone to a bar with Kornell and another man the night of the murder and returned to his hotel room alone before midnight to sleep. When he awoke an hour later to use the bathroom, the woman was lying dead on the floor.
He said he wrapped the body in a sheet and fled, fearing he would be blamed for her death.
Von Starck will become eligible for parole after 20 years. His attorneys said they would appeal the verdict.
